what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as site_engineer.audit. Looked for any place showing whether the company owes me money for expenses or petty cash I hold. Tried Home, Today, My time, Inbox (all three filters, opened Change request #6), Projects and its Work/Documents tabs, avatar menu/My account, the + menu, the scope picker, global search (petty cash, expense), and the Ask chat (two questions). No balance, wallet, petty cash or reimbursement view was found. The only expense route is 'Record expense' / 'Site expense' form (a form with a 'Paid through: Your petty cash' option) which records new expenses but shows no balance or amount owed. Ask chat answered both questions with a generic capability message.
incorrect_navigation_attempts: Record expense form (entry, not a view)
Projects list and Work tab ('No record types yet')
Inbox Change requests (all filters) and Change request #6 (an unrelated task update)
unnecessary_steps: Opening the expense form just to look for a balance
Asking chat twice with the same non-answer
confusing_terminology: Work -> 'Records / Reports / Notices' unclear what they contain
Change requests -> unclear it relates to approvals
Paid through: Your petty cash -> implies a petty cash balance exists but none is viewable
missing_feedback: Ask chat gave generic reply instead of saying it cannot show balances
Search returned only 'Nothing found' with no suggestions
First chat text typed before input focus was silently lost
No visible confirmation of what changed when Inbox count rose from 1 to 2
unexpected_behaviour: Today's site report card changed from 'Not sent yet' to 'Waiting for approval' during my session though I did not knowingly submit one
Inbox badge rose from 1 to 2 without an action I recognised
errors_encountered: No record types yet. Ask the Admin to install a business pack.
visual_issues: Icon-only top buttons (search, scope target, +, refresh) have no text labels
Theme icons in avatar menu are ambiguous
Different page header styles: My account has no tabs or breadcrumb
accessibility_issues: Small grey helper text is low contrast
Keyboard use not tested via Tab beyond Enter in fields
observations: No page anywhere shows money owed to the employee or cash held. A new user would conclude the feature does not exist for this role. Expense recording is easy to find; viewing its outcome is not.

rating_justifications.feature_discoverability: Searched ~45 actions across all nav, search and chat; no balance or reimbursement view exists or is findable.
rating_justifications.ease_of_use: Objective could not be achieved; chat and search both gave dead ends.
rating_justifications.clarity_of_terminology: Work/Records/Notices, Change requests and Files to sort were unclear; 'petty cash' appears only as a form option.
rating_justifications.workflow_efficiency: Many screens visited with nothing relevant.
rating_justifications.system_feedback: Chat replied with an irrelevant generic message; search said only 'Nothing found.'; unexplained status changes and badge count rise.
rating_justifications.overall_user_experience: Polished but unable to answer a basic money-owed question.
